The '''capital of Orto''' was located on [[Orto/Legends|Orto]]. It was occupied by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and played host to the undercover operations of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nem Bees]].
